messages.text: Psalm 31:24 — 'Be strong and take heart, all you who hope in the Lord.' Thinking of you and Derek today ❤️
Have you two set a date yet? I'm not getting younger and I want grandchildren while I can still lift them.
We're not there yet. Things are... complicated.
Life is complicated, Sarah. Marriage is complicated. You think your father and I didn't have hard years? But we STAYED. That's what love IS.
Dad never threw plates at the wall.
Nothing. I have to go. Meeting.
I ran into Mrs. Holloway at the pharmacy. She said Derek has been calling her crying. What's going on?
I'm thinking about leaving him, Mom.
SARAH ELIZABETH REYNOLDS. That man gave up his BODY for you. You cannot abandon him because things got HARD.
He didn't give up his body FOR me. It was an accident. And he's cruel to me every day.
He's in PAIN, baby. Pain makes people say things they don't mean.
He means them, Mom. He told me nobody else would want me. He threatened to post about the accident. He's not in pain. He's vicious.
...you're not seeing clearly. You're tired. Go to church this Sunday. Pray on it.
I don't need prayer. I need support. Actual support. Not guilt wrapped in Bible verses.
Watch your tone. I am still your mother.
And I'm still your daughter. But I'm also a PERSON. Goodbye, Mom.
